gap13_update.title: A verifiable Indian reference institution
gap13_update.phase9_wording: No competitor demonstrates a LARGE INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with named referees and third-party verification.
gap13_update.phase10_finding: FURTHER NARROWED. Protrak (ProrIISe), built jointly by IISc Bengaluru and Prorigo Software, is a NAMED INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with hard, vendor-published metrics: in production 6+ years, 2,500+ internal and external users, 600+ corporate licence agreements, ~200 patents filed per year, 50% IP-office time saved, 0 missed deadlines, 30% faster contract closure, ~50% cost saving versus other ELM products.
gap13_update.surviving_claim: A named Indian university reference now exists for IP MANAGEMENT (Protrak/IPTeL, IISc). No named Indian university reference exists for INCUBATION or PROGRAMME software - the category StartupHub actually competes in. That distinction is the whole finding: the institutional reference gap is segment-specific, not universal.

ecosystem.name: Startup India Hub
ecosystem.gives: 50,000+ startup directory; investors, mentors, incubators, accelerators; 30+ government bodies registered; free tools, templates, courses, challenges; Innovation Challenges with cash grants
ecosystem.takes_back: **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.** No IIC activity, no ARIIA/NIRF evidence, no TRL. This is the single most important line in this phase.
ecosystem.overlap: DIRECT on networking, directory, mentors, incubators. ZERO on institutional innovation compliance.

ecosystem.name: BHASKAR
ecosystem.gives: Bharat Startup Knowledge Access Registry; personas Mentor, Enabler, Explorer, Startup Founder, Individual Investor, Traditional Business Owner; industry alliances by sector/tech/geography
ecosystem.takes: a completed profile before you become visible and searchable
ecosystem.takes_back: **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.** Identity layer, not an innovation record.
ecosystem.overlap: Identity and discovery. No institutional compliance overlap at all.
ecosystem.note: Registration now redirects through BHASKAR before DPIIT recognition runs in parallel.

ecosystem.name: MAARG
ecosystem.gives: AI mentor-startup matching at scale; interaction tracking for impact; video calls; mentor recognition; custom programmes by enablers; feedback and grievance mechanism
ecosystem.takes_back: **NOTHING BACK TO INSTITUTIONS.** Mentorship hours are not logged against any scheme's utilisation requirement.
ecosystem.overlap: DIRECT on mentor matching. This is the closest government analogue to StartupHub's mentor module.
ecosystem.note: GAP-07 (NDA-tiered mentor visibility) is NOT solved here either.

ecosystem.name: Startup India Investor Connect
ecosystem.gives: dedicated platform connecting startups to investors by sector, function, stage, geography, background
ecosystem.note: Launched at the 6th NSAC meeting, 11 March 2023.

ecosystem.name: IIC Portal
ecosystem.gives: Institution's Innovation Council registration; star rating 1–5; Performance Card; 16+ activities/year each a full evidence submission
ecosystem.takes: 16+ evidence submissions per year, maintained by hand
ecosystem.takes_back: Nothing - this IS the record. But it returns nothing machine-readable.
ecosystem.overlap: **TOTAL, AND MANDATORY.** No institution can opt out. This is the demand driver.

ecosystem.name: YUKTI-NIR
ecosystem.gives: TRL banding (Idea/PoC 1–4, Innovation/Prototype 5–9, Business/Startup); institute-side verification with Recommended/Not-Recommended gating; auto-flows to ARIIA
ecosystem.takes_back: Improved ARIIA Section 4 ranking - a budget line that already exists.
ecosystem.note: GOV-023/024. The reason TRL is non-optional (GAP-02).

ecosystem.name: NIRF Innovation
ecosystem.gives: Ranking; 5 marks hinge on one countable (startups recognised)
ecosystem.note: GOV-028. Phase 3A measured the operational cost: 32/354 startups lose identity (9%).

ecosystem.name: ARIIA
ecosystem.gives: Ranking; incumbent performance data; 100+ indicators across 5 categories
ecosystem.note: GOV-032. Demands 'Patent Application No' and 'Year of Patent Application' - the mandate behind GAP-01.

ecosystem.name: AISHE
ecosystem.gives: National registry; the statistical frame behind every count in this study
ecosystem.overlap: Indirect - it defines the market, not the workflow.
ecosystem.note: 58,643 registered HEIs - the super-bound from Phase 7.

ecosystem.name: State Startup Portals
ecosystem.gives: State Startup Ranking (SRF) results; policy schemes; state nodal teams
ecosystem.overlap: Segment G9 - sized separately in Phase 7 on the PRIOR tier.
ecosystem.note: Phase 6: 34 states ranked, 8 fell tiers, 0 Emerging-tier reports obtainable.
